statements.impact_statement: github.com/jackc/pgx/v5 v5.7.1 is in the affected range (<5.9.0; fixed in 5.9.0), so the package is present. No first-party Go file imports github.com/docker/docker or any of its daemon, api, client or pkg packages (0 hits). The vulnerable code is the daemon's server-side archive handler. It never runs in headscale or its tests, because the daemon is a separate external process.

statements.impact_statement: golang.org/x/net is a direct requirement at v0.32.0. The advisory says versions before 0.33.0 are affected, so the version is in range. The vulnerable code is the golang.org/x/net/html package: Parse, ParseWithOptions, ParseFragment and ParseFragmentWithOptions. No first-party Go file imports that package or calls those functions. The only x/net package the repository uses is x/net/http2, imported at hscontrol/noise.go:14. To my knowledge http2 does not import x/net/html, but I could not confirm this because the Go module cache is outside the sandbox. There is no vendor directory. go.mod declares no HTML-parsing libraries such as goquery, bluemonday or goldmark. Limitation: I could not inspect transitive dependencies such as tailscale.com, so a transitive import of x/net/html is not ruled out. statements.impact_statement: CVE-2025-47913 (GO-2025-4116 / GHSA-56w8-48fp-6mgv) affects golang.org/x/crypto before 0.43.0. The flaw is in the ssh/agent client: it panics when an agent answers with SSH_AGENT_SUCCESS where a typed response is expected. This repository resolves golang.org/x/crypto to v0.31.0 (go.mod), which is in the affected range, so the package is present. However, first-party Go code imports only golang.org/x/crypto/acme, acme/autocert and bcrypt. Nothing imports golang.org/x/crypto/ssh or ssh/agent, and there are no calls to agent.NewClient, ssh.Dial or similar. The only route left is a transitive one, through tailscale.com/tsnet (hscontrol/tailsql.go). pkg.go.dev shows that tsnet does not directly import tailscale.com/ssh/tailssh. tailssh imports only golang.org/x/crypto/ssh, not ssh/agent.
